title: GMSK Modulator
text: 使用高斯最小频移键控 (GMSK) 方法调制数据位，输入 3 路、输出 3 路；按 {Symbol prehistory} 指定符号前史；{Bandwidth time product} 指定高斯脉冲形状的带宽与符号时间的乘积、{Pulse length} 指定脉冲长度、{Phase offset (rad)} 指定调制波形的相位偏移、{Number of samples per symbol} 指定每个符号的采样数、{Number of data points} 指定数据点数、{Output type} 输出类型 Vector、{Output word length} 输出字长、{Enable reset input port} 指定重置信号，按实例取值。

ports.name: valid
ports.summary: 指示有效的输入数据 scalar

ports.name: data
ports.summary: 调制后的复值输出数据符号 complex scalar | complex column vector

ports.name: valid
ports.summary: 指示有效的输出数据 scalar

params.name: Bandwidth time product
params.values: 高斯脉冲形状的带宽与符号时间的乘积 0.3 (default) | positive scalar value

params.name: Pulse length
params.values: 脉冲长度 8 (default) | positive integer in the range from 1 to 16

params.name: Symbol prehistory
params.values: 符号前史 1 (default) | -1 | vector of –1s or 1s with length equal to L – 1

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: 调制波形的相位偏移 0 (default) | numeric scalar in the range from -2*π to 2*π.

params.name: Number of samples per symbol
params.values: 每个符号的采样数 4 (default) | in the range 1 to 64

params.name: Number of data points
params.values: 数据点数 1024 (default) | positive integer within the range 65,536 and a power of 2

params.name: Output word length
params.values: 输出字长 16 (default) | positive scalar value with word length less than 16
